items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Ted Kelley was the other trombone, in Tyree's place. ... So Ted never got back in the band, so it left just Lawrence and myself.

ctx.x:
We had three trombones when we started
out. Ted Kelley was the other trombone, in Tyree's place. And
Ted Kelley got over there and we was there two weeks, and he
had promised this girl that he was going to marry her and he
came all the way back to the United States to marry this girl.
And after he got married he asked Duke if he could come back
and Duke told him no, there was no use in him coming back there
for just two more weeks, you know. So Ted never got back in
the band, so it left just Lawrence and myself.

And we get to Italy, Lawrence got sick -- he had
trouble with his back and he had to lay on a board all night --
that left me by myself. I was playing Lawrence's solos, play-
ing Tricky Sam's chair, and I would take different parts and
whatever part that I thought would fit in different spots, see?
I would play that part whether it was first, second, or third,
whatever I thought would fit. And I had to do that by myself
until we got back.
